verdict.rationale: Vast.ai's docs tell users to query prices programmatically with `vastai search offers`, using filters such as `rentable=true`, and publish an OpenAPI spec. Hands-on probes confirmed that both the CLI search and a bare GET to the `/api/v0/bundles/` REST endpoint return live offers with per-hour prices and no account or API key, so an agent can comparison-shop before spending anything. missing for 10: first-party documentation explicitly stating that the bundles/offer-search endpoint is public and keyless (only shown by probe), and independent corroboration that the listed availability is accurate.

support.subject: As an AI agent, I can query the GPU catalog with live pricing and availability from a public or documented endpoint before committing any spend

citations.quote: searched the LIVE GPU marketplace with NO account and NO API key, returning real RTX 4090 offers with CUDA versions, vCPUs, RAM, disk, and per-hour prices
a bare keyless GET to https://console.vast.ai/api/v0/bundles/ returned live marketplace offers as JSON including `dph_total` (per-GPU-hour price)
CLI: Use vastai search offers to query prices programmatically
vastai search offers 'gpu_name=RTX_4090 num_gpus=1 verified=true direct_port_count>=1 rentable=true' -o 'dlperf_usd-'
